01 THE PERSON BEHIND THE CODE

REAL PROBLEMS.
PRACTICAL SOLUTIONS.

I build the systems that help people
do their best work.

I’m a full-stack engineer with more than nine years of experience building production business software, including ERP, invoicing, POS, e-commerce, and B2B platforms.

Twice, I joined a company as its first engineer, established the IT function, and hired and led the team. I replaced manual, paper-based operations with systems designed around the people using them.

My work connects the bigger picture to the details: understanding the problem, shaping a practical solution, and writing the code that brings it into production.
